name: Moon With Face
desc: A great gouache moon-face drifting in a starfield, halo breathing on the beat, lidded eyes that blink and wink on section changes, mood brightening with the music.

style.doc: aesthetic: matte painterly / stipple-hatch woodcut / form-from-light no-outline / 2-ink misregistration / luminous stained-glass

act.doc: program: nightfall = mood tracks intensity, phases = slow terminator/waxing sweep over minutes
